source: First stanza of 'I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud' by William Wordsworth (1807, public domain). Heading, note, glossary and questions written for Padi by the project author and released with the repository.

blocks.text: William Wordsworth wrote this poem after a walk beside a lake with his sister Dorothy. Read the stanza aloud and notice the rhyme at the end of each line.

lines: I wandered lonely as a cloud
That floats on high o'er vales and hills,
When all at once I saw a crowd,
Beside the lake, beneath the trees,
Fluttering and dancing in the breeze.
